description:
Vengeance from beyond the grave! After the 'Finger Killer' murders her parents, Lieutenant Oh Sujeong vows to find the culprit. Kim Taejin, also a victim, rises from his grave, and together they seek justice for their families...    

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=9116957), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/by_evil), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000060504)

**Official Translations:**  
English ([HyperComic](https://play.hypercomic.io/Webtoon/episode/69/), [Dashtoon](https://dashtoon.com/comics/read/evil-tendencies_SHOuoaZyDJb4sv882VK), [MangaPlaza](https://mangaplaza.com/title/0303011555/)), [S.Chinese](https://www.kuaikanmanhua.com/web/topic/8029/), [Japanese](https://www.amazon.co.jp/-/en/dp/B0BTMNVD1F/)
